transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess... I just can't keep my mind on one thing lately. I work at a warehouse, and... well, every little noise pulls me away. A beeper, a forklift, someone moving a pallet. I just lose track of what I'm doing. Then I realize I've put the wrong numbers in the inventory. It's just... getting hard to focus.
Do you often find yourself fidgeting or feeling restless when you're supposed to be sitting still?

I suppose... yeah. After my shifts, I really should be worn out, but... lately I just come home buzzing. I try to sit on the couch and it just... it feels impossible. So I end up, I don't know, reorganizing the kitchen cabinets. Or going out and sorting the bins in the garage. I just can't seem to stop moving.
Do you often act on impulse, doing things without fully thinking them through?

I suppose... maybe sometimes. I just... well, recently I went to a few craft markets. I ended up buying a lot of things. Paints, frames, some tools. I don't really know, I just... I was sure I was going to turn it all into something useful. 

But... I spent way more than I should have. Seeing the credit card bill now, it's... it's pretty embarrassing, honestly. I'd rather not dwell on it.
Have you recently done anything impulsive that didn't involve spending money?
I don't... no, not really. Not that I can think of. I mostly just go to work and come home. It was really just the... the shopping.
Do you usually feel upset, anxious, or stressed before you do something impulsive?
No, I don't... I don't think so. I wasn't upset or anything. I just... I don't know, it just seemed like a good idea at the time. I don't really get anxious like that.
Do you often find yourself talking a lot more than others in social situations?

I guess... my husband says I do. Sometimes my coworkers at the warehouse mention it, too. They say I talk really fast... about recipes, or safety ideas for work, or those art classes I wanted to take. They say they can't get a word in. I don't really mean to, I just... I feel like if I don't get the whole thought out right then, it'll just disappear. So I have to finish it. But I don't know if I talk *more* than everyone else, really.
Have you noticed any problems in your relationships with family or friends since you started having these issues with focus and impulsivity?

Well... I guess things have been a little tense. My husband and I, we've been arguing some. He's retired now, and... it just feels like we're kind of walking on eggshells around each other instead of enjoying the time. And at work... I've made a few mistakes with the inventory. I've had to go back and double-check things with my supervisor. So... yeah, I suppose it's caused a few issues.
Do you think your difficulties with focus and impulsivity are affecting your job performance or overall well-being?

Well... like I just said... yes. It's... it's affecting things. The inventory errors at the warehouse, I've had to go to my supervisor about those. And... well, at home, the arguing with my husband. It's just... we're just walking around each other. It's not how his retirement is supposed to be. So... yes.
Do you experience these difficulties with focus and impulsivity at home as well as at work?

Yes... I mean, I think I just went over that. It's both. At work, I'm having to double-check things with my supervisor because of those inventory errors. And at home... like I said, my husband and I are just arguing. We're walking around each other instead of actually settling into his retirement. So... yes, it's both places.
Do you have days where you don't feel restless or have trouble focusing?
Not really... no. It's, um... it's been going on for about a month now. Just pretty much every day since he stopped working and our whole routine changed.
Have you experienced significant difficulties with organization or time management at work or home?
I don't... I don't think so. Not really. Just what I already mentioned.
Do you have trouble focusing or feel restless even when you're doing things you enjoy?
I guess... I haven't really noticed. I don't know. I haven't been doing much of anything I enjoy lately anyway.
Do you feel restless or have trouble focusing even when you're doing leisure activities that you normally find relaxing?
Like I said... I haven't really been doing anything like that lately. So... I don't know. I guess not.
Do you have trouble focusing when you're by yourself at home?
No... not really. I'm usually just sitting around when I'm home anyway. There isn't really much I need to focus on.
Do you feel like you're always on the go even when you're doing things you're supposed to be enjoying?

I mean... maybe a little. After my shifts at work, I should be worn out. Usually I am. But lately I come home and I'm just... buzzing, I guess. Sitting on the couch just feels impossible right now. So I end up out in the garage sorting bins, or... reorganizing the kitchen cabinets. Just to be doing something. I don't know.
Do you feel restless or have trouble focusing during your daily activities at the warehouse and at home equally, or is it worse in one place than the other?

I guess... probably at work. At the warehouse. That's actually kind of what brought me in. I just... I can't keep my mind on one thing anymore. 

Every little noise catches me. A beeper, or a forklift alarm... or even just someone moving a pallet. It pulls me right off my count. And then... well, I realize I've put the wrong numbers into the inventory.
Do you think your main problem is that you can't focus on things or that you act on impulses without thinking?

I don't really know... I haven't thought about it like that. I guess it's mostly just... not being able to focus. I don't think I'm doing things without thinking. Just... getting distracted, like I said.
Do you feel restless or have trouble focusing when you're doing quiet activities by yourself?
I don't know... I guess so. Sometimes. It's hard to say. I just... I don't really do a lot of quiet things lately.
Do you feel restless or have trouble focusing when you're on your days off from work?
I guess... yeah, maybe a little. I try to just stay busy on my days off, so... I don't really notice it as much. But I suppose I still get a bit jumpy.
Do you have trouble focusing at home when you're not doing anything work-related?
I'm not really sure. I guess I don't pay that much attention to it. When I'm home, I just... try to get things done around the house. So I haven't really noticed.
